display_name: 短线王 · A 股短线复盘工作台
description_zh: 盘中看昨日涨停股能否延续强势，收盘对照连板梯队与当天记录的涨停原因，次日核对昨晚写下的判断。WorkBuddy 帮你在本机装好短线王，接入 AI，打开就能从最近一个交易日开始复盘。
description_en: Track yesterday’s limit-up stocks, review which themes and streaks held up at the close, and check your observations the next trading day. WorkBuddy sets up Askill on your computer and connects it to your account.
author: Barryyangdong
examples_zh: 帮我安装短线王并接入 WorkBuddy，验证一次对话，带我打开最近一个交易日的收盘复盘。
打开我已有的短线王，带我找到「次日验证」，我想核对昨天写下的观察条件。
我的短线王能打开，但 AI 没回复。帮我检查连接，修好后在工作台验证一次。
examples_en: Install Askill, connect WorkBuddy, verify a reply, and open the latest trading day’s closing review.
Open my existing Askill workspace and show me where to check the observations I recorded yesterday.
Askill opens, but the AI does not reply. Check the connection, fix it, and verify a reply in the workbench.
